fields.name: patentId
fields.description: Nexscope internal patent ID. Only a single value is supported; multiple values separated by commas are not allowed. Max length: 60,000 characters

fields.name: patentNumber
fields.description: Publication (grant) number. Only a single value is supported; multiple values separated by commas are not allowed. Max length: 60,000 characters

fields.name: replaceByRelated
fields.description: Whether to substitute with a family patent's abstract when the abstract is unavailable: 1 Yes, 0 No. Default 0

fields.name: lang
fields.description: Target translation language. Options: en (English, default), cn (Chinese), jp (Japanese). Max length: 1,000 characters
